initial_query: I am looking for an existing commercial unit. I intend to assess a conversion into a play space / baby parking (hourly childcare), subject to confirmation of the applicable authorization regime. I need a property with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 15 people. I prefer a property in energy class D or better.

requirements.description: User prefers energy class D or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through D.

The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area, so the total surface is filtered with a >= threshold. The 15-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold from the RegulatoryAgent is available. The energy class requirement is not a reference column and is not applied.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 115 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') ORDER BY id ASC
output.explanation: Applied the two requirements that map to allowlisted columns: surface_area >= 115 (strictest, listed first) and energy_class in A1-D. The tipologia_bene_immobile requirement was ignored because that column is absent from filterable_columns (the filterable equivalent is property_type), so the allowlist rule excludes it. No location was supplied, so the result is ordered by id ASC. No LIMIT is applied.
